title: Product resume and fork reject supported v1 sessions
claim: The Reference Product cannot resume, normalize, or fork an actual schema-v1 session because both product operations require read_validated_with_recovery, which rejects every header whose version is not 2; the registered Phase 17 legacy migration tests do not detect this because their write_legacy_session helper now creates a schema-v2 envelope.

evidence.detail: resume_session calls SessionReader::read_validated_with_recovery; fork_session calls resume_session.
read_validated_with_recovery returns InvalidData whenever header.version != FORMAT_VERSION (2), with the explicit message that a legacy session is read-only.
write_legacy_session uses SessionHeader::new and SessionWriter::create; at current HEAD those APIs produce a v2 header and required-entry envelopes.
The artifact produced by the passing P17-A13 test begins with version 2 and a direct_runtime_input binding, so it is not an existing v1 fixture.

title: DirectRuntimeInput digest omits material run inputs
claim: For session-backed product runs, the finalized manifest's DirectRuntimeInput digest is derived only from cwd and the session's initial model and remains unchanged after a provider/model switch, so the binding does not digest the resolved material inputs used by the run as required by the Phase 17 evidence contract.

evidence.detail: session_runtime_input_binding hashes only the literal prefix, cwd, and initial model.
rebind_evidence_capture computes current model, system, tool schemas, inference, runtime, adapter, material configuration, and policy-derived facts for each run.
setup_evidence_run overwrites that freshly derived binding with the session's fixed binding before sink setup.
The provider-switch acceptance test explicitly asserts that alpha and beta manifests retain the same binding while their adapter configuration identities differ.
The public SessionHeader::new fallback similarly fabricates a direct binding from session id, timestamp, cwd, and parent session rather than resolved material runtime inputs.

title: Audited remediation commit has no three-platform CI evidence
claim: There is no GitHub Actions run for audit_head 528989279e9be308abc963ec22f377ee47bbde47, so the mandatory Linux/macOS/Windows acceptance requirements cannot be assessed for the current implementation after a commit that changed Phase 17 production and test surfaces.

evidence.detail: The read-only GitHub Actions query returned an empty JSON array.
The audited commit changes 40 files, including opi-agent, opi-ai, opi-coding-agent production code, session schema, evidence, provider decoding, and acceptance tests.
The strongest counter-evidence is a successful CI run for parent 136c380f0c5eea541190cc1a0f5c1d62f983b4e8, not for the audited commit.

title: Shell-completion tests break the required external Cargo-cache gate
claim: The shell-completion integration binary hard-codes workspace-local target/release and target/debug paths instead of Cargo's test binary path, causing all eight tests and cargo test --workspace --all-targets to fail under the repository-required external Cargo target directory.

evidence.detail: opi_bin derives the workspace root and selects only workspace_root/target/release/opi or workspace_root/target/debug/opi.
The active canonical target directory was E:/opi/cargo-targets/windows-direct, where Cargo built opi.exe.
0 passed and 8 failed with os error 3 because the constructed checkout-local target/debug/opi.exe path did not exist.
The required workspace gate is cargo test --workspace --all-targets and repository work must use the external Cargo cache workflow.

title: Bedrock accepts a terminal stream followed by a truncated frame
claim: The production Bedrock decoder leaves an incomplete frame buffered at transport EOF but never rejects the leftover bytes; if a valid messageStop was decoded first, saw_done remains true and the call can finish successfully despite the truncated trailing frame.

evidence.detail: parse_frames deliberately leaves a frame whose declared total length exceeds the current buffer for a future append.
The HTTP loop parses after every chunk but does not check that buffer is empty when bytes_stream returns None.
EOF flushes a pending Done and checks only mapper.saw_done; a prior messageStop makes that check pass even if buffer still contains a truncated frame.
Current regression coverage rejects CRC-invalid complete frames, but has no valid-terminal-plus-truncated-trailer production fixture.
